title: Aloha Tiki Tours
specs: First and only 18 passenger tiki boats in the Midwest
Covered tiki roof for rain or shine
Ages 12 and up welcome; must be accompanied by parent or guardian if under 18
Must sign digital waiver before boarding; captain checks valid ID
Max weight limit 2300 lbs per boat
No swimming allowed; follow captain's rules
Must be 21 or older to consume alcohol
Standard boats hold up to 6 guests; Big Kahuna boats hold up to 18 guests; 30 passenger boat holds up to 30 guests
Multiple boats can be booked for larger groups

blurb: Guests book private tiki boats for 2-hour cruises with a USCG-certified captain. They bring their own drinks and snacks, and enjoy a covered tiki roof and Bluetooth music. Tours operate May 5th through October 1st, rain or shine, with safety equipment and restroom breaks included.
